headline: DILG Pushes Stronger Gun-Owner Liability After Zamboanga School Shooting
seoTitle: DILG Pushes Stronger Gun-Owner Liability | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News midday brief reports renewed DILG proposals for stricter firearm-storage accountability after the Ateneo de Zamboanga shooting.
deck: The policy debate focuses on legal responsibility when minors or unauthorized people gain access to firearms.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News midday package reports that the DILG and police leadership called for stronger accountability for firearm owners whose weapons are accessed by minors or other unauthorized persons after the Zamboanga school shooting.
The package also discusses possible amendments to the firearms law. FMB News is not treating every proposed technical storage measure in the package as enacted policy.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Republic Act No. 10591 regulates firearm ownership and imposes licensing and safekeeping obligations. Any new criminal-liability standard or storage mandate would require formal legal or regulatory action.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The debate affects household safety, government-issued firearm custody and the legal responsibilities of licensed owners.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the DILG, PNP and Congress for the text of any proposed amendments, implementing rules or administrative directives.
